title: Off The Shelf “Wilderness” First Aid Kits
description: A look at two off the shelf first aid kits sold at REI.
description_translated: A look at two off the shelf first aid kits sold at REI.
author: PrepMedic
comment_text:
I have owned many Adventure Medical kits over the years.  They were available in sporting goods stores long before YouTube.  I appreciate your advice and critique; however, you failed to familiarize yourself with the Adventure Medical product line which ranges from very basic first aid to more comprehensive and in various categories to backpacking, car camping, water sports, hunting and even world travel.  My first QuitClot package was in a specific package for abrasions and bleeding - Adventure Medical made QuitClot available long before I saw other rescue first aid companies making it available to non paramedic users.  My first SOFTT was purchased in a small trauma kit from Adventure Medical.
All premade kits need to be supplemented, but I don’t expect an IFAK from a $50 basic kit.  Review the kit for its intended purpose -  I haven’t just owned their kits, there have been times their kits saved a vacation or at least provided relief when it was needed.
I drive a Jeep now and I have a fairly good med kit and I have even supplemented that with a North American CAT tourniquet, QuikClot, and Leatherman Raptor Shears all attached to the outside of the kit.  The kit is prominently secured right below one of my two fire extinguishers attached to the left and right rear roll cage bars.

When I am creek fishing or day hiking, I need a basic lightweight first aid kit.  When I engage in an off road sport where I’m responsible for my own self rescue, I carry what is recommended by my peers and then some.  I also carry a Garmin InReach and a satellite phone.

Please take the time to understand a companies product line and take the niche they are marketing to into consideration (there is a reason and a market for each of those two kits - the yellow one I have used kayaking, the blue one I have used car camping, fishing and general travel).
I take your advice seriously and have implemented your recommendations from many of your other videos that apply to my particular situation.

description: A look at two off the shelf first aid kits sold at REI.

author: PrepMedic
comment_text:
Great video. I’m really glad that the focus of the video is that these FAKs aren’t used for life threatening scenarios and combat situations. These kits are for people who are hiking and camping, where the chances of suffering a gunshot wound is extremely slim.

I work out in the woods pretty extensively and always carry one of these in my pack and my truck. 

Any wilderness first aid course worth its salt teaches how to improvise splints, stretchers, etc. and when you’re outdoors where weight matters, being able to improvise these tools is much more effective than carrying them with you. 

Some stuff I personally always carry if I don’t have a full IFAK with me is hockey tape, water, and some kind of multi tool. I’ve had to deal with situations where myself or a coworker has been injured and that’s all I’ve had, and it goes A LONG way, trust me. Having something to clean/flush a wound (water, tweezers or knife), and something to wrap a wound efficiently (hockey tape, some gauze or clean cloth) is all you need in 90% of scenarios you’ll run into. 

Definitely be familiar with any kit you’re carrying, and just remember that knowledge and practice will save a life. I won’t say that I’d prefer a booklet to a course, but I’d prefer a booklet to nothing. Stay safe!

title: அகதிகளுக்கு சிங்கப்பூர் செஞ்சிலுவைச் சங்கம் ஆதரவுக்கரம்
description: அகதிகளுக்கு சிங்கப்பூர் செஞ்சிலுவைச் சங்கம் ஆதரவுக்கரம் 06 Apr 2022 - 5:30 am 1 mins read SHARE சிங்கப்பூரர்கள் நன்கொடை வழங்கிய மருத்துவச் சாதனங்கள் உக்ரேனிய அகதிகளைச் சென்றடைவதை உறுதி செய்ய ஐரோப்பாவுக்குச் சென்றுள்ள சிங்கப்பூர் செஞ்சிலுவைச் சங்கத்தின் இரு அதிகாரிகள். படம்: சிங்கப்பூர் செஞ்சிலுவைச் சங்கம் - ரஷ்யா-உக்­ரேன் போரால் ஐரோப்­பா­வில் அக­தி­க­ளின் எண்­ணிக்கை நாளுக்கு நாள் அதி­க­ரித்து வரு­கிறது. அவர்­க­ளுக்கு உத­வும் வகை­யில் $1.12 மில்­லி­யன் பெறு­மா­ன­முள்ள மருத்­துவ, முத­லு­த­விச் சாத­னங்­களை அது அனுப்­பு­கிறது. உக்­ரே­னின் அண்டை நாடு­களில் அக­தி­கள் எண்­ணிக்கை அதி­க­ரித்­துள்­ளது. சிங்­கப்­பூ­ரர்­கள் நன்­கொடை வழங்­கி­யுள்ள மருத்­துவ, முத­லு­த­விச் சாத­னங்­கள் அக­தி­க­ளைச் சென்­ற­டை­வதை உறுதி செய்ய இரு­வர் கொண்ட குழுவை ஹங்­கே­ரிக்கு அனுப்­பி­யுள்­ள­தாக சிங்­கப்­பூர் செஞ்­சி­லு­வைச் சங்­கம் கூறி­யது. இரு­வ­ரும் ஹங்­கே­ரியை நேற்று முன்­தி­னம் அடைந்­த­னர். அங்கு அக­தி­க­ளுக்கு அளிக்­கப்­படும் மனி­தா­பி­மான உத­வி­யை­யும் சிங்­கப்­பூ­ரர்­கள் அனுப்­பி­யுள்ள மருத்­துவ, முத­லு­த­விச் சாத­னங்­கள் விநி­யோ­கிக்­கப்­ப­டு­வ­தை­யும் அவர்­கள் மேற்­பார்­வை­யி­டு­வர். "உக்­ரே­னில் மனி­தா­பி­மான நெருக்­க­டி­நிலை மிக­வும் மோச­மாக உள்­ளது. நிலைமை தொடர்ந்து மோசமடைந்து வருகிறது. "மிக எளி­தில் பாதிப்­ப­டை­யக்­கூ­டி­ய­வர்­கள், குறிப்­பாக சிறார், இளை­யர்­கள், பெண்­கள், குழந்­தை­கள், மூத்­தோர், அரிய வகை நோயால் பாதிக்­கப்­பட்­டி­ருப்­ப­வர்­கள், உடற்­கு­றை­யுள்­ளோர் ஆகி­யோ­ருக்கு முன்­னு­ரிமை வழங்­கு­கி­றோம்," என்று சிங்­கப்­பூர் செஞ்­சி­லு­வைச் சங்­கத்­தின் தலை­மைச் செய­லா­ளர் பெஞ்­ச­மின் வில்­லி­யம் தெரி­வித்­தார். அக­தி­க­ளுக்­குத் தேவை­யான அவ­ச­ர­கால தங்­கு­மி­டம், சுகா­தா­ரம், உள­வி­யல் ஆத­ரவு ஆகிய அடிப்­ப­டைத் தேவை­க­ளைப் பூர்த்தி செய்ய சிங்­கப்­பூர் செஞ்­சி­லு­வைச் சங்­கம் தொடர்ந்து முயற்சி செய்­யும் என்று தெரி­விக்­கப்­பட்­டது. போலந்து எல்­லை­க­ளின் வழி­யாக உக்­ரே­னிய நக­ரங்­க­ளுக்கு கிட்­டத்­தட்ட 3,000 மருத்­து­வச் சாத­னங்­களை அனுப்ப சிங்­கப்­பூ­ரில் உள்ள உக்­ரே­னிய மன்­றத்­து­டன் சங்­கம் இணைந்து செயல்­ப­டு­கிறது. இது­வரை சிங்­கப்­பூர் செஞ்­சி­லு­வைச் சங்­கம் மொத்­தம் $3.66 மில்­லி­யன் பெறு­மா­ன­முள்ள உத­வியை உக்­ரே­னிய அக­தி­க­ளுக்­காக அனுப்பி வைத்­துள்­ளது. இச்செய்தியைப் பகிரவும் SHARE
description_translated: Singapore Red Cross lends hand to refugees 06 Apr 2022 - 5:30 am 1 mins read SHARE Two officials from the Singapore Red Cross have traveled to Europe to ensure that medical equipment donated by Singaporeans reaches Ukrainian refugees. Image: Singapore Red Cross - The number of refugees in Europe is increasing day by day due to the Russia-Ukraine war. It is sending $1.12 million worth of medical and first-aid equipment to help them. The number of refugees in Ukraine's neighboring countries has increased. The Singapore Red Cross said it has sent a two-man team to Hungary to ensure that medical and first-aid supplies donated by Singaporeans reach the refugees. Both reached Hungary yesterday. They will oversee humanitarian aid to refugees there and the distribution of medical and first-aid supplies sent by Singaporeans. "The humanitarian crisis in Ukraine is dire. The situation continues to deteriorate. We are giving priority to the most vulnerable, especially minors, youth, women, children, the elderly, those with rare diseases and those with physical disabilities," said Singapore Red Cross Society Secretary General Benjamin William. The association is working with the Ukrainian Forum in Singapore to send nearly 3,000 medical devices across the Polish borders. So far, the Singapore Red Cross has sent a total of $3.66 million in aid to Ukrainian refugees. Share this story

description: மியன்மாருக்கு சிங்கப்பூர் செஞ்சிலுவைச் சங்கம் கூடுதலாக $550,000 உதவிப்பொருள்கள் 10 Apr 2025 - 6:14 pm 1 mins read SHARE நிலநடுக்கத்தால் மியன்மாரில் உருக்குலைந்த கட்டடம். - படம்: மியன்மார் செஞ்சிலுவைச் சங்கம் AI SUMMARISE IN ENGLISH Singapore Red Cross commits another $550,000 worth of supplies for Myanmar quake aid The Singapore Red Cross Society (SRC) will increase aid to Myanmar earthquake victims by $550,000, providing health products, mats, mosquito nets, and tarpaulins for approximately 8,000 families, particularly women. This distribution will be handled by the SRC office in Myanmar. title: 人协与红十字会合作鼓励民众积极捐血
description: 人协与红十字会合作 鼓励民众积极捐血 冠病疫情让人们意识到，生活在充满变数的世界已成为新常态，走出疫情也并未让世界免受动荡不安的影响。新加坡将在2026年成为“超老龄化”社会，加上气候变化和恐怖威胁，都凸显了社区紧急应变小组的重要。 人民协会与新加坡红十字会星期二（4月30日）签署谅解备忘录，鼓励民众积极捐血，并通过海外体验计划，强化人协社区紧急应变小组，以及社区紧急应策与参与委员会领袖的紧急应变能力。 今年1月，我国O型血的库存量一度处于临界水平。内政部兼社会及家庭发展部政务部长孙雪玲星期二出席人协社区紧急应变小组成立20周年庆祝活动启动仪式时指出，由于社会老龄化，符合捐血条件的人逐年减少，一旦国家血库耗尽，将对我国的医疗保健系统带来灾难性后果。 “无论是年轻人还是年长者，每个人都可能面临改变人生的事件。为了防止出现此类紧急情况，我们须采取积极措施，通过让年轻人更多参与，确保我国未来的血液安全。” 提升海外社区援助能力 获得适用本地实际经验 另外，人协也将与新加坡红十字会合作，通过提升海外社区援助能力，获得适用于新加坡的实际经验，为气候异常的情况做好准备。紧急应变小组成员等人会在接受红十字会的培训后，前往经历紧急情况的邻国，支援灾后社区恢复等工作，从而积累第一手经验，了解如何在发生紧急状况时将这类经验应用于我国。 延伸阅读 5300名公众响应捐血 O型血库存量增230％ 11月起 人协为社区志愿服务计划提供项目津贴 谢国强是参加人协与红十字会推出的海外体验计划的首批成员之一，他1999年曾赴台湾支援地震救灾。（叶振忠摄） 谢国强（57岁）是参加人协与红十字会推出的海外体验计划的首批成员之一。1999年台湾发生“九二一”大地震后，他作为民防战备人员，曾与同袍赴台湾支援救灾。 谢国强忆述，当年台湾地震救援现场余震连连，摇摇欲坠的混凝土板就在几英尺外，还有不知是食物还是遗体腐烂导致的恶臭。如今25年过去了，当年的一幕幕仍让他记忆犹新。 他说，尽管这次要参与的海外体验计划不会比当年的地震救援更危险，但仍颇具挑战。“当你抵达现场后，应该帮助当地民众，而不应抱着游客的心态去，我们得切记这一点。而且我们的居住和饮食条件都应该与当地人一样，不能给当地民众添麻烦，别要求对方提供额外的安排。” 为提升住宅区防火安全，民防部队已逐步为每两座组屋配置一个灭火器，放在已装置自动心脏除颤器（AED）的电梯口。此外，新加坡红十字会也提供免费心肺复苏和AED课程。谢国强鼓励本地居民充分利用这些资源，积极掌握社区紧急应变的能力。“不论是垃圾着火，还是心脏骤停，许多事故都是由小发展到大的，及早介入就能避免后续的损失。” 2004年成立的人协社区紧急应变小组，如今有8000名成员，他们都具备急救、消防和人群控制方面的知识。新加坡红十字会今年庆祝成立75周年。 人民协会 新加坡红十字会 捐血 孙雪玲 上一篇 Ninja Van和雅虎裁员 共约40人受影响 下一篇 报告：未来三个月 过半企业有意增聘人手 购买此文章
description_translated: The People's Association of China and the Red Cross cooperate to encourage people to actively donate blood. The COVID-19 epidemic has made people realize that living in a world full of uncertainties has become the new normal. The emergence of the epidemic has not spared the world from the impact of turmoil. Singapore will become a "super-aging" society by 2026, coupled with climate change and terrorist threats, all highlighting the importance of community emergency response teams. The People's Association and the Singapore Red Cross signed a memorandum of understanding on Tuesday (April 30) to encourage the public to actively donate blood and strengthen the emergency response capabilities of the People's Association Community Emergency Response Team and the leaders of the Community Emergency Response and Participation Committee through overseas experience programs. In January this year, my country's stock of type O blood was at a critical level. Sun Xueling, Minister of State for the Ministry of Home Affairs and Ministry of Social and Family Development, attended the launching ceremony of the 20th anniversary celebration of the establishment of the People's Association of my country Community Emergency Response Team on Tuesday and pointed out that due to the aging of society, the number of people eligible for blood donation has been decreasing year by year. Once the national blood bank is exhausted, it will have catastrophic consequences for our country's health care system. "Whether they are young or old, everyone may face life-changing events. To prevent such emergencies, we must take proactive measures to ensure our country's future blood safety by involving more young people." Improve overseas community assistance capabilities and gain practical local experience. In addition, the People's Association will also cooperate with the Singapore Red Cross to gain practical experience applicable to Singapore by improving overseas community assistance capabilities and prepare for abnormal climate situations. After receiving training from the Red Cross, emergency response team members and others will go to neighboring countries that have experienced emergencies to support post-disaster community recovery and other work, thereby accumulating first-hand experience and understanding how to apply this experience to our country when emergencies occur. Extended reading 5,300 members of the public responded to donate blood, and the inventory of type O blood increased by 230%. Starting from November, the People’s Association provided project subsidies for community volunteer service plans. Xie Guoqiang was one of the first members to participate in the overseas experience program launched by the People’s Association and the Red Cross. In 1999, he went to Taiwan to support earthquake relief. (Photo by Ye Zhenzhong) Xie Guoqiang (57 years old) is one of the first members to participate in the overseas experience program launched by the People's Association and the Red Cross. After the "September 21" earthquake occurred in Taiwan in 1999, as a civil defense preparer, he and his colleagues went to Taiwan to support disaster relief. Xie Guoqiang recalled that there were aftershocks at the Taiwan earthquake rescue site that year. The crumbling concrete slab was just a few feet away, and there was a stench caused by food or rotting corpses. Now 25 years have passed, and the scenes from that year are still fresh in his memory. He said that although the overseas experience plan he will participate in this time will not be more dangerous than the earthquake rescue that year, it is still quite challenging. "When you arrive at the scene, you should help the local people and should not go there with the mentality of tourists. We have to keep this in mind. And our living and dietary conditions should be the same as those of the locals. We should not cause trouble to the local people and do not ask them to provide additional arrangements." In order to improve fire safety in residential areas, the Civil Defense Force has gradually equipped every two HDB houses with a fire extinguisher and placed it at the elevator entrance where an automatic cardiac defibrillator (AED) is installed. In addition, the Singapore Red Cross also provides free CPR and AED courses. Xie Guoqiang encouraged local residents to make full use of these resources and actively master the community's emergency response capabilities. "Whether it's a garbage fire or a cardiac arrest, many accidents develop from small to large. Early intervention can avoid subsequent losses." The People's Association Community Emergency Response Team, established in 2004, now has 8,000 members, all of whom have knowledge of first aid, firefighting and crowd control. The Singapore Red Cross celebrates its 75th anniversary this year. title: 5300名公众响应捐血 O型血库存量增230％
description: 5300名公众响应捐血 O型血库存量增230％ 公众积极响应当局的捐血呼吁，让国家血库的O型血库存量回升，增加230％，能更好地应对任何民事或医疗紧急情况。 卫生部长王乙康星期天（2月4日）在 脸书贴文 ，向过去一星期来踊跃捐血的约5300名捐血者致谢，并指出挺身而出的公众来自社会各阶层，反应令人鼓舞。 血库的O型血库存量日前跌破六天，处于临界水平。新加坡红十字会和卫生科学局于1月25日发出联合文告，呼吁O型血的公众在农历新年前捐血，从而确保国家血库能维持至少九天的血液储备。 过去一星期来，超过5300名捐血者捐血，血库收集到近3300单位的O型血，让库存量提升230%至大约17天。 王乙康的帖子强调，虽然库存量恢复，但还是需要公众继续捐血，维持这个强劲的势头。“佳节期间的捐血量通常会减少两成。随着农历新年的脚步靠近，血库的库存量仍然面对下跌的可能。” 延伸阅读 响应号召 黄嫊方陈泓宇捐血 本地O型血库存告急 急需捐献者 新加坡红十字会和卫生科学局星期天也发出联合文告，感谢捐血者。文告指出，由于血制品的保存期限短，红血球只有六星期，而血小板只有七天，因此需要公众积极捐血以维持稳定的血液供应。 当局鼓励所有捐血者定期至少每年捐血两次，确保有足够血液供应给本地病人。 O型血俗称“万能血”，是输注红血球的通用血型，可在病人血型不明的紧急情况下使用。此外，近一半本地病人是O型血，只能接受O型血。 王乙康 卫生科学局 新加坡红十字会 捐血 上一篇 里峇峇利路一办公室被指是电子烟分销基地 下一篇 星期六下午豪雨来袭 杜尼安路突发淹水 购买此文章
description_translated: 5,300 members of the public responded to donate blood, and the stock of type O blood increased by 230%. The public actively responded to the authorities’ call for blood donations, allowing the national blood bank’s stock of type O blood to rebound and increase by 230%, allowing it to better respond to any civil or medical emergency. Health Minister Ong Ye Kung posted on Facebook on Sunday (February 4) to express his gratitude to the approximately 5,300 blood donors who have actively donated blood in the past week, and pointed out that the public who came forward came from all walks of life and the response was encouraging. The blood bank's inventory of type O blood recently fell below six days and is at a critical level. The Singapore Red Cross and the Health Sciences Authority issued a joint statement on January 25, calling on the public with type O blood to donate blood before the Chinese New Year to ensure that the national blood bank can maintain blood reserves for at least nine days. In the past week, more than 5,300 blood donors donated blood, and the blood bank collected nearly 3,300 units of type O blood, increasing the inventory by 230% to approximately 17 days. Ong Ye Kung's post emphasized that although the inventory has recovered, the public still needs to continue donating blood to maintain this strong momentum. "The amount of blood donations during the festive season usually decreases by 20%. As the Chinese New Year approaches, blood bank stocks are still facing the possibility of decline." Extended reading Responding to the call, Huang Chengfang and Chen Hongyu donate blood. The local O-type blood stock is in short supply and donors are urgently needed. The Singapore Red Cross and the Health Sciences Authority also issued a joint statement on Sunday to thank blood donors. The statement pointed out that due to the short shelf life of blood products, red blood cells are only six weeks and platelets are only seven days, so the public needs to actively donate blood to maintain a stable blood supply. title: 红十字会与泡泡玛特合作 捐血送盲盒
description: 红十字会与泡泡玛特合作 捐血送盲盒 新加坡红十字会与泡泡玛特（Popmart）合作送盲盒给捐血者，三个参与活动的血库预约火热，红十字会透露自从推行活动后，参与捐血的人数增长一倍。 新加坡红十字会与泡泡玛特早前在10月2日至10月17日之间的六个特定日期，在位于西城大厦（Westgate Tower）、榜鹅综合社区中心（One Punggol）和兀兰的血库为捐血者送上惊喜盲盒。 由于公众反响热烈，红十字会日前宣布延长这项活动，新一轮的赠送活动将从10月27日至11月7日推行。 公众应事先在网上接受问答测试看是否符合捐血条件，随后在上述参与活动的三家血库预约时段，并在当天注册时输入指定的团体代码。成功献血者可获得一个盲盒，这些盲盒将随机赠送，送完为止。 负责献血者计划的新加坡红十字会集团局长普拉卡什·梅农（Prakash Menon）受询时说，自从展开这项合作以来，捐血者人数翻了一倍。 延伸阅读 认领血库计划扩大 鼓励企业团体协助稳定血液供应 “我们鼓励更多的年轻人积极参与献血。我们希望借助这些合作，激发更多年轻人对捐血的兴趣，并推动他们倡导捐血。” 《新明日报》记者星期六（11月1日）尝试在上述三家血库预约捐血，但网站资料显示，周末两天的时段都已订满。 有意捐血者可上网： https://giveblood.sg/ 了解详情。 完整报道，请翻阅2025年11月2日的《新明日报》。 捐血 泡泡玛特 红十字会 上一篇 取额外碗盘收2角 摊贩：洗碗费涨成本增 下一篇 公寓居民：住家外不准摆鞋 鞋架还被拆除 购买此文章
description_translated: Red Cross and Popmart cooperate to donate blood and send blind boxes. The Singapore Red Cross and Popmart have cooperated to send blind boxes to blood donors. The three participating blood banks have been busy booking. The Red Cross revealed that since the launch of the activity, the number of people participating in blood donation has doubled. The Singapore Red Cross and Pop Mart have previously delivered surprise blind boxes to blood donors at blood banks located at Westgate Tower, One Punggol and Woodlands on six specific dates between October 2 and October 17. Due to the overwhelming response from the public, the Red Cross recently announced the extension of this event, and a new round of donation activities will be implemented from October 27th to November 7th. The public should take a question-and-answer test online in advance to see if they meet the conditions for blood donation, then make a reservation at the three participating blood banks mentioned above and enter the designated group code when registering on the day. Successful blood donors will receive a blind box, which will be given away at random while supplies last. Prakash Menon, group director of the Singapore Red Cross Society who is in charge of the blood donor programme, said when asked that the number of blood donors has doubled since the launch of this collaboration. Further reading, the Blood Bank Adoption Program expands and corporate groups are encouraged to help stabilize the blood supply. "We encourage more young people to actively participate in blood donation. We hope to use these cooperation to stimulate more young people's interest in blood donation and promote their advocacy of blood donation." A reporter from Shin Min Daily News tried to make an appointment for blood donation at the above three blood banks on Saturday (November 1), but the website information showed that the time slots for both weekends were fully booked. Those interested in donating blood can go to: https://giveblood.sg/ for details. For the complete report, please read the Shin Min Daily News on November 2, 2025. title: 支援弱势建韧性社会 红十字会召义工加入千人急救队
description: 支援弱势建韧性社会 红十字会召义工加入千人急救队 新加坡红十字会发起“韧性响应者”运动，目标是动员1000名训练有素，能投入急救工作的义工，以支援弱势群体，建立更具韧性的社会。 红十字会学院将为他们提供标准急救及自动体外除颤器（AED）、心理急救、为孤独老人提供陪伴（Befriending）三方面的培训。 逐步增加对独居者 高危儿童及租赁组屋年轻人等群体支援 新加坡红十字会主席陈开河星期二（10月3日）在颁奖典礼上致辞时指出，我国未来几年将面临严峻的社会挑战，尤其是家庭规模缩小和人口快速老龄化，因此红十字会须调整服务内容。红十字会将在未来两年扩大人道服务的覆盖范围，逐步增加对包括独居者在内的年长者和高危儿童，以及住在租赁组屋的年轻人的支援。 “韧性响应者”（Responder for Resilience）运动正是实现这一目标的途径之一。 红十字会赞助人尚达曼总统星期二出席颁奖典礼，并为翻新后的红十字会之家（Red Cross House）揭幕。红十字会之家去年6月开始翻新，不仅增设升降电梯，也采用低能耗照明、太阳能板和废水收集池。 延伸阅读 人口老龄化血液需求增 榜鹅设第五个血库 新加坡红十字会为SGSecure推出首个心理急救培训 尚达曼总统：韧性响应者运动让更多人成为技术精湛义工 尚达曼说：“新加坡红十字会体现了我们希望发展为国民性格一部分的品质：不断努力帮助弱势群体并促进国内外的团结。‘韧性响应者’运动的启动，将让更多人成为技术精湛，为人类服务的义工。” 今年的华侨银行“骑车乐”脚踏车大会（OCBC Cycle）上，一名六旬男子在设置围栏时突然倒下，心脏骤停。当时在场的救生员之一谢谦（35岁，盛港综合医院危机管理人员）立即实施心肺复苏术（CPR），使用自动体外除颤器抢救，将男子从鬼门关拉了回来。 谢谦的贡献受到肯定，成为今年新设的红十字会救生员奖的两名得主之一。他透露，最初是因为不想玩游戏浪费时间，想学些有意义的东西回馈社会，才在2016年加入红十字会救护车服务，从标准急救流程学起，逐渐掌握更多急救知识。他说：“我只是做了该做的事，我觉得每一名医护人员都有资格获奖。” 116个人与机构获表扬 患躁郁症义工：没看扁自己 获颁表彰奖的谢秀云（57岁）12岁时就得在社会上谋生帮补家用，母亲2014年患上失智症，2017年患上大肠癌，如今住疗养院。医护人员悉心照料母亲，让她对照顾年长者产生兴趣，于2018年成为义工。 如今在快餐店当服务生的谢秀云每周工作五天，仍能抽出时间与年长者聊天，或带他们出门游玩。谈及获奖，她哽咽地说：“虽然我有躁郁症（bipolar disorder），但我没有看扁自己。” 红十字会今年表扬了116名个人和机构，感谢他们对人道主义事业的贡献。其中，前艺人沈倾掞因在乌克兰危机中与新加坡红十字会展开人道主义合作，成为新加坡红十字会之友奖得主之一。 年满16岁的新加坡居民可上网 volunteer.redcross.sg/training 报名成为“韧性响应者”，培训可用两个周末完成。 新加坡红十字会 尚达曼 义工 弱势群体 红十字会 心肺复苏术 沈倾掞 上一篇 男童脑瘤压迫多个神经 接受质子治疗康复 下一篇 国会观察：守了门就进不了球？ 购买此文章
description_translated: To support the disadvantaged and build a resilient society, the Red Cross calls for volunteers to join the 1,000-person first aid team. The Singapore Red Cross has launched the "Resilient Responders" campaign, with the goal of mobilizing 1,000 volunteers who are well-trained and able to engage in first aid work to support the disadvantaged and build a more resilient society. The Red Cross Academy will provide them with training in standard first aid and automated external defibrillator (AED), psychological first aid, and befriending for lonely elderly people. Gradually increase support for groups such as those living alone, high-risk children and young people renting HDB flats. Singapore Red Cross Chairman Tan Kai Ho pointed out in his speech at the award ceremony on Tuesday (October 3) that our country will face severe social challenges in the next few years, especially the shrinking of family size and the rapid aging of the population. Therefore, the Red Cross must adjust its service content. The Red Cross will expand the coverage of humanitarian services in the next two years and gradually increase support for the elderly and at-risk children, including those living alone, as well as young people living in rental housing. The Responder for Resilience movement is one way to achieve this goal. President Tharman Shanmugaratnam, Patron of the Red Cross, attended the awards ceremony on Tuesday and unveiled the renovated Red Cross House. The Red Cross House began renovations in June last year, not only adding lifts, but also using low-energy lighting, solar panels and wastewater collection tanks. Further reading Demand for blood increases due to aging population Punggol opens fifth blood bank Singapore Red Cross launches first psychological first aid training for SGSecure President Tharman Shanmugaratnam: The Resilience Responder movement enables more people to become skilled volunteers. "Singapore Red Cross embodies the qualities we hope to develop as part of the national character: continuous efforts to help the disadvantaged and promote unity at home and abroad. The launch of the 'Resilience Responder' movement will enable more people to become skilled volunteers in the service of humanity," said Tharman Shanmugaratnam. At this year's OCBC Cycle Cycling Conference (OCBC Cycle), a man in his sixties suddenly collapsed while setting up a fence and suffered a cardiac arrest. One of the lifeguards present at the time, Xie Qian (35 years old, crisis management officer of Sengkang General Hospital), immediately performed cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) and used an automated external defibrillator to rescue the man, and brought the man back from the dead. Xie Qian's contribution was recognized and he became one of the two winners of this year's new Red Cross Lifeguard Award. He revealed that he initially joined the Red Cross ambulance service in 2016 because he did not want to waste time playing games and wanted to learn something meaningful to give back to the society. He started by learning standard first aid procedures and gradually mastered more first aid knowledge. He said: "I just did what I should do. I think every medical staff is qualified to win the award." 116 individuals and organizations were commended. Volunteers with bipolar disorder: did not underestimate themselves. Xie Xiuyun (57 years old), who received the commendation award, had to make a living in society to help support the family when he was 12 years old. His mother suffered from dementia in 2014 and colorectal cancer in 2017, and now lives in a nursing home. The medical staff took good care of my mother, which made her interested in caring for the elderly, and she became a volunteer in 2018. Nowadays, Xie Xiuyun works as a waiter in a fast food restaurant five days a week, but still finds time to chat with the elderly or take them out for fun. Talking about winning the award, she choked up and said: "Although I have bipolar disorder, I do not underestimate myself." The Red Cross commended 116 individuals and organizations this year for their contributions to humanitarian causes. Among them, former artist Sim Qinghuan became one of the recipients of the Friends of the Singapore Red Cross Award for her humanitarian cooperation with the Singapore Red Cross during the Ukraine crisis. Singapore residents aged 16 and above can sign up to become "Resilience Responders" online at volunteer.redcross.sg/training, and the training can be completed over two weekends. title: 认领血库计划扩大 鼓励企业团体协助稳定血液供应
description: 认领血库计划扩大 鼓励企业团体协助稳定血液供应 卫生科学局与新加坡红十字会宣布扩大“认领血库计划”，并创设“捐血伙伴奖”，鼓励企业和团体同血库建立长期合作关系，以壮大全国捐血网络，确保血液供应稳定。 卫生部兼数码发展及新闻部政务部长拉哈尤星期六（11月1日）在西城大厦（Westgate Tower）血库10周年庆上致辞时，宣布“认领血库计划”（Adopt a Bloodbank）扩大的消息。她说，西城大厦血库10年来建立起一个定期捐血的忠实捐血群，其中超过630人每年至少捐血一次，展现了社会关怀与凝聚力。 “认领血库计划”去年8月推出，已有35个机构参与，涵盖全国五个血库。为进一步提高血库的可持续性，红十字会采用四级合作架构，让企业和组织根据参与度和捐血动员成效逐级提升。 属于较高等级的合作伙伴可在红十字会数码平台上展示标识，获得额外宣传机会，并享有优惠参与急救培训课程、联办活动及捐血者感恩计划。 卫生科学局与红十字会也鼓励企业通过其他方式支持血库，例如赞助产品、提供广告空间或以专业知识协助推广献血文化。 延伸阅读 首次捐血者年限明年起调高至65岁 “世界献血者日”说捐血 一袋热血 生灵有望 创设“捐血伙伴奖” 表扬推动献血文化的机构 为了肯定各方的种种支持，红十字会将从明年起，配合世界献血者日（每年6月14日）颁发“捐血伙伴奖”，表扬在鼓励捐血方面作出特别贡献的机构。 西城大厦血库自2015年启用以来，已接纳了超过6万2600名捐血者，累计收集了超过21万5000个单位的血液，占全国血液供应约17％。目前有七个机构认养这座血库，包括新加坡武装部队单位和私人企业等。 印度族泰米尔纳德宗族协会Kinds Family是认养机构之一。发言人普拉布（Prabhu Packirisamy，石油天然气总监，43岁）受访时说，协会两年前开始发起到西城大厦血库捐血，迄今已有约180名会员参与。“一公升的血能拯救三个生命，我们承诺每年至少捐血100次。” 协会定本月、12月和明年2月到西城大厦血库捐血。 退休人士邓家辉（64岁）在西城大厦血库捐血已经79次。他受访时说，第一次捐血是在2000年，那时只是纯粹想帮助他人，后来隔了多年才继续献血。“2007年，我女儿生病了，经常进出医院，后来好多了。那时候，我觉得受惠于医护人员，就决定更常去捐血，在能力范围内回馈社会。” 卫生科学局局长蔡瑞文教授（医生）在周年庆上讲话时说，企业是推动献血文化的重要伙伴，企业管理层应把认领血库视为有意义的企业志愿活动。这不仅能为社会作出贡献，也能协助国家建立稳定的血液供应。 卫生科学局与红十字会星期六也在卫生科学局血库举办万圣节主题派对，以创意方式鼓励年轻人迈出捐血的第一步。 年底血液库存常下滑 当局吁公众提前捐血 卫生科学局发言人答复《联合早报》询问时透露，过去一年，全国只有约1.3％人口（包括居民与非居民）曾捐血。 发言人说，每到年底学校假期与节庆期间，血库存量往往会下滑，所有血型的库存可能减少多达两成。旅游旺季也会影响人们捐血，因为人们如果从有虫媒疾病风险的地区旅游回国，须暂停一段时间才可以捐血。 卫生科学局呼吁公众，在年终出外旅行前提早安排捐血，并鼓励通过“捐血”（DonateBlood）手机应用、拨打6220 0183，或浏览网站 Giveblood.sg ，了解更多捐血资讯和预约捐血时间。 卫生科学局 新加坡红十字会 捐血 上一篇 农耕义工团体“聚友爱”新址下周启用 续造绿色可持续甘榜教育园 下一篇 各政府机构正密切关注柔佛两起污染事件 本地水质和渔场不受影响 购买此文章
description_translated: The Health Sciences Authority and the Singapore Red Cross announced the expansion of the "Add-a-Blood Bank Program" and the creation of the "Blood Donation Partner Award" to encourage businesses and groups to establish long-term cooperative relationships with blood banks to strengthen the national blood donation network and ensure a stable blood supply. On Saturday (November 1), Minister of State for the Ministry of Health and Ministry of Digital Development and Information Rahayu announced the expansion of the "Adopt a Bloodbank" program (Adopt a Bloodbank) when delivering a speech at the 10th anniversary celebration of the Westgate Tower Blood Bank. She said that Xicheng Building Blood Bank has established a loyal blood donation group that regularly donates blood in the past 10 years. More than 630 of them donate blood at least once a year, demonstrating social care and cohesion. The "Adopt a Blood Bank Program" was launched in August last year, and 35 institutions have participated, covering five blood banks across the country. To further improve the sustainability of blood banks, the Red Cross adopts a four-level cooperation structure that allows companies and organizations to increase their levels based on participation and blood donation mobilization effectiveness. Partners belonging to higher tiers can display their logo on the Red Cross digital platform, gain additional publicity opportunities, and enjoy discounted participation in first aid training courses, joint events, and blood donor appreciation programs. The Health Sciences Authority and the Red Cross also encourage businesses to support blood banks through other means, such as sponsoring products, providing advertising space or providing expertise to help promote blood donation culture. Extended reading: The age limit for first-time blood donors will be raised to 65 next year. "World Blood Donor Day" says that donating blood can save lives with a bag of warm blood. The "Blood Donation Partner Award" has been created to commend organizations that promote blood donation culture. In order to recognize the various supports from all parties, the Red Cross will issue the "Blood Donor Partner Award" in conjunction with World Blood Donor Day (June 14 every year) from next year to commend organizations that have made special contributions in encouraging blood donation. Since its opening in 2015, the West City Building Blood Bank has received more than 62,600 blood donors and collected more than 215,000 units of blood, accounting for about 17% of the national blood supply. There are currently seven organizations adopting this blood bank, including units of the Singapore Armed Forces and private companies. Kinds Family, an Indian clan association in Tamil Nadu, is one of the adoption agencies. Spokesperson Prabhu Packirisamy, director of oil and gas, 43 years old, said in an interview that the association started donating blood at the West City Building Blood Bank two years ago, and so far about 180 members have participated. "One liter of blood can save three lives. We promise to donate blood at least 100 times a year." The association plans to donate blood at the Xicheng Building Blood Bank this month, December and February next year. Retired man Tang Jiahui (64 years old) has donated blood 79 times at the West City Building Blood Bank. When interviewed, he said that the first time he donated blood was in 2000. At that time, he just wanted to help others. Later, he continued to donate blood after many years. "In 2007, my daughter was sick and was often in and out of the hospital, but she got better later. At that time, I felt that I had benefited from the medical staff, so I decided to donate blood more often and give back to the society within my ability." Professor Choi Swee-man (a doctor), Director of the Health Sciences Bureau, said in his speech at the anniversary that companies are important partners in promoting blood donation culture, and corporate management should regard blood bank adoption as a meaningful corporate volunteer activity. This will not only contribute to society, but also assist the country in establishing a stable blood supply. The Health Sciences Authority and the Red Cross are also hosting a Halloween-themed party at the Health Sciences Authority Blood Bank on Saturday to creatively encourage young people to take the first step in donating blood. Blood stocks often decline at the end of the year, and the authorities urge the public to donate blood in advance. In response to inquiries from Lianhe Zaobao, a spokesman for the Health Sciences Bureau revealed that only about 1.3% of the country's population (including residents and non-residents) had donated blood in the past year. The spokesman said that blood stocks tend to decline during year-end school holidays and festivals, and stocks of all blood types may decrease by as much as 20%. The peak tourist season also affects people's blood donation, because if people return from traveling to areas with insect-borne disease risks, they have to stop for a period of time before they can donate blood. The Health Sciences Authority calls on the public to make arrangements for blood donation in advance before traveling at the end of the year, and encourages the public to learn more about blood donation information and make appointments for blood donation through the "DonateBlood" mobile app, dial 6220 0183, or visit the website Giveblood.sg. title: 为什么要捐血？得奖献血者告诉你！
description: 为什么要捐血？得奖献血者告诉你！ 受疫情影响，本地2021年的捐血人数是这五年来最低的；而捐血群众中，尤以青年与女性捐血者为数最少。 6月14日是世界献血者日，新加坡红十字会与卫生科学局配合这个日子举行仪式，表扬本地1834名冠军献血者与25个流动献血主办方，感谢他们对2021年全国捐血计划的宝贵贡献。 这次的荣耀奖（Champions of Champions）有38名得主，当中的徐玉珍（房地产经纪）已连续捐血44年，共捐出130袋血。 她也是今年新加坡红十字会荣耀奖唯一的女献血者。 徐玉珍受访时透露，女捐血者向来为数甚少，而她的坚持，是因为家族的传统。 徐玉珍说：“父亲常告诉我们，救人一命，胜造七级浮屠；若有能力挽救他人的生命，就要尽力而为。我的九个兄弟姐妹都有捐血的习惯。” 44年不曾间断的捐血历程中，徐玉珍试着邀约更多女性来捐献。她说：“我尝试向同事们介绍，她们总是说我自己的血都不够用，我来月经感觉要晕倒了，所以真的很难劝女性来捐血。” “而且很多女性想保持苗条的身材，所以她们会吃得很少又吃得不健康，所以这是个恶性循环，你的血细胞指数自然会很低，无法捐血。” 另一名得奖者是新跃社科大学（SUSS）学生廖永盛（23岁，市场营销系一年级），他是今年新加坡红十字会捐血铜奖得主，也是其中一名最年轻的得奖者。他七年来捐献了29袋血。 廖永盛说：“我小时候，妈妈常进出医院动手术，常常都会需要输血。这让我在14、15岁时就想捐血救人。但是最低捐血年龄是16岁，所以我16岁生日那星期就自己去捐。” 不但如此，廖永盛还极力号召同学、朋友去捐血。他说：“我在中学，到理工学院、大学念书，甚至当兵，都会很努力地叫他们一起来捐血，差不多找了20多人来捐。”其中有两名朋友也和廖永盛一样，变成了长期捐血者。 他说：“我自己是觉得捐血有一种很大的充实感，因为我花那一点点时间就可以做到挺大的贡献，因为一袋血可以救三个人。” 根据卫生科学局的数据显示，十年前捐血者当中差不多有33%都是16到25岁的青年，可是这个数字到了2021年仅剩20%。 身为长期的青年捐血者，廖永盛说：“青年捐血者人数每年都在减少，新加坡人口老化是其中一个原因，老人不可以捐，所以年轻人更需要尽责，应该过来捐血。” 这两年因疫情起伏不定的缘故，公众减少外出，也不那么主动前去捐血。 除此之外，国家血库不允许人们成群去捐血，海外归国的人也要等七天后才能捐血。而冠病患者确诊后更要等28天才能再次捐血。种种因素导致去年捐血人数相较往年，大幅度减少。 受疫情影响，本地2021年的捐血人数是近年最低（制图/洪惠贞） 卫生科学局按新加坡统计局的数据计算出，2018年本地公民与永久居民捐血者比率为1.84%，2019年为1.87%，2020年是1.78%。去年的数据是近年最低的，近400万本地公民与永久居民当中，只有1.73%捐血者。 而捐血者当中，相较男性，女性略少，只占39%。跟首次捐血者和定期捐血者相比，青年捐血者只有20%。 捐血群众中，尤以青年与女性捐血者为数最少。（制图/洪惠贞） 新加坡红十字会将走进社区和校园，举办宣导教育活动，与大众分享献血知识，鼓励更多人定期献血。在本地，16岁至60岁的人都可以献血。 红十字会也在手机页面新推出手机游戏（Iron—Rich food dash），用游戏介绍高铁质食物，让公众了解，哪些食物有助于增加血液中的铁质。同时，今年也开放让公众参与压力球的设计，未来去捐血的人都能领到新设计的压力球。 新加坡红十字会 捐血 上一篇 万元送网红“女友” 惊觉她很多情郎 两男报警 下一篇 国大将推出培训课程 让前线人员助低收入家庭规划财务
description_translated: Why donate blood? The winning blood donor tells you! Affected by the epidemic, the number of local blood donors in 2021 is the lowest in the past five years; among the people who donate blood, young people and women especially have the smallest number of blood donors. June 14 is World Blood Donor Day. The Singapore Red Cross and the Health Sciences Authority held a ceremony in conjunction with this day to commend 1,834 local champion blood donors and 25 mobile blood donation organizers for their valuable contributions to the national blood donation program in 2021. There are 38 winners of the Champions of Champions this time. Among them, Xu Yuzhen (real estate agent) has been donating blood for 44 consecutive years and donated a total of 130 bags of blood. She is also the only female blood donor to receive the Singapore Red Cross Honor Award this year. In an interview, Xu Yuzhen revealed that there have always been very few female blood donors, and her persistence was due to family tradition. Xu Yuzhen said: "My father often told us that saving one life is better than building a seven-level pagoda; if you can save the lives of others, you should do your best. All nine of my brothers and sisters have the habit of donating blood." During the 44 years of continuous blood donation, Xu Yuzhen tried to invite more women to donate. She said: "I tried to introduce it to my colleagues, but they always said that my own blood is not enough. I feel like fainting when I get my period, so it is really difficult to persuade women to donate blood." "And many women want to maintain a slim figure, so they eat less and unhealthy, so it is a vicious circle. Your blood cell index will naturally be very low and you will not be able to donate blood." Another award winner is Singapore University of Social Sciences (SUSS) student Liow Yong Seng (23 years old, first-year marketing major). He is this year’s Singapore Red Cross Blood Donation Bronze Award winner and one of the youngest winners. He donated 29 bags of blood in seven years. Liao Yongsheng said: "When I was a child, my mother often went in and out of the hospital for operations and often needed blood transfusions. This made me want to donate blood to save lives when I was 14 or 15 years old. But the minimum age for blood donation is 16 years old, so I donated myself during the week of my 16th birthday." Not only that, Liao Yongsheng also strongly called on his classmates and friends to donate blood. He said: "When I was in middle school, studying in polytechnics, universities, and even in the military, I would work hard to get them to donate blood. I found more than 20 people to donate blood." Two of his friends also became long-term blood donors like Liao Yongsheng. He said: "I personally feel that donating blood has a great sense of fulfillment, because I can make a big contribution by spending a little time, because one bag of blood can save three people." According to data from the Health Sciences Bureau, almost 33% of blood donors ten years ago were young people aged 16 to 25, but this number only remained at 20% in 2021. As a long-term youth blood donor, Liao Yongsheng said: "The number of young blood donors is decreasing every year. Singapore's aging population is one of the reasons. The elderly are not allowed to donate, so young people need to be more responsible and should come and donate blood." Due to the ups and downs of the epidemic in the past two years, the public has gone out less and is less active in donating blood. In addition, the national blood bank does not allow people to donate blood in groups, and people who have returned from overseas must wait seven days before donating blood. Patients with coronavirus have to wait 28 days after being diagnosed before donating blood again. Various factors led to a significant decrease in the number of blood donors last year compared with previous years. Affected by the epidemic, the number of local blood donors in 2021 is the lowest in recent years (Chart/Hong Hye Jung) The Health Sciences Authority calculated based on data from the Singapore Bureau of Statistics that the ratio of local citizens to permanent residents blood donors in 2018 was 1.84%, in 2019 it was 1.87%, and in 2020 it was 1.78%. Last year’s data was the lowest in recent years, with only 1.73% of the nearly 4 million local citizens and permanent residents donating blood. Among blood donors, there are slightly fewer women than men, accounting for only 39%. Compared with first-time blood donors and regular blood donors, only 20% are young blood donors. Among the people who donate blood, young people and women in particular have the least number of blood donors. (Drawing/Hong Hye Jung) The Singapore Red Cross will go into communities and schools to hold publicity and education activities to share blood donation knowledge with the public and encourage more people to donate blood regularly. Locally, people aged 16 to 60 can donate blood. The Red Cross has also launched a new mobile game (Iron-Rich food dash) on its mobile page, using the game to introduce high-iron foods to let the public understand which foods can help increase iron in the blood. At the same time, this year, the public is also allowed to participate in the design of the stress ball. In the future, anyone who donates blood will receive the newly designed stress ball. Another award winner is Singapore University of Social Sciences (SUSS) student Liow Yong Seng (23 years old, first-year marketing major). He is this year’s Singapore Red Cross Blood Donation Bronze Award winner and one of the youngest winners. He donated 29 bags of blood in seven years. Liao Yongsheng said: "When I was a child, my mother often went in and out of the hospital for operations and often needed blood transfusions. This made me want to donate blood to save lives when I was 14 or 15 years old. But the minimum age for blood donation is 16 years old, so I donated myself during the week of my 16th birthday." Not only that, Liao Yongsheng also strongly called on his classmates and friends to donate blood. He said: "When I was in middle school, studying in polytechnics, universities, and even in the military, I would work hard to get them to donate blood. I found more than 20 people to donate blood." Two of his friends also became long-term blood donors like Liao Yongsheng. He said: "I personally feel that donating blood has a great sense of fulfillment, because I can make a big contribution by spending a little time, because one bag of blood can save three people." According to data from the Health Sciences Bureau, almost 33% of blood donors ten years ago were young people aged 16 to 25, but this number only remained at 20% in 2021. As a long-term youth blood donor, Liao Yongsheng said: "The number of young blood donors is decreasing every year. Singapore's aging population is one of the reasons. The elderly are not allowed to donate, so young people need to be more responsible and should come and donate blood." Due to the ups and downs of the epidemic in the past two years, the public has gone out less and is less active in donating blood. In addition, the national blood bank does not allow people to donate blood in groups, and people who have returned from overseas must wait seven days before donating blood. Patients with coronavirus have to wait 28 days after being diagnosed before donating blood again. Various factors led to a significant decrease in the number of blood donors last year compared with previous years. Affected by the epidemic, the number of local blood donors in 2021 is the lowest in recent years (Chart/Hong Hye Jung) The Health Sciences Authority calculated based on data from the Singapore Bureau of Statistics that the ratio of local citizens to permanent residents blood donors in 2018 was 1.84%, in 2019 it was 1.87%, and in 2020 it was 1.78%. Last year’s data was the lowest in recent years, with only 1.73% of the nearly 4 million local citizens and permanent residents donating blood. Among blood donors, there are slightly fewer women than men, accounting for only 39%. Compared with first-time blood donors and regular blood donors, only 20% are young blood donors. Among the people who donate blood, young people and women in particular have the least number of blood donors. (Drawing/Hong Hye Jung) The Singapore Red Cross will go into communities and schools to hold publicity and education activities to share blood donation knowledge with the public and encourage more people to donate blood regularly. Locally, people aged 16 to 60 can donate blood. The Red Cross has also launched a new mobile game (Iron-Rich food dash) on its mobile page, using the game to introduce high-iron foods to let the public understand which foods can help increase iron in the blood. At the same time, this year, the public is also allowed to participate in the design of the stress ball. In the future, anyone who donates blood will receive the newly designed stress ball. description_translated: The Nanyang Hakka Association and the Huizhou Association jointly organized a charity performance to raise more than NT$800,000 for the Red Cross. The Nanyang Hakka Association and the Singapore Huizhou Association jointly organized the 2025 Singapore Red Cross "One Home·Love 60" charity performance, raising more than NT$800,000. Donations will be used to support humanitarian aid for local vulnerable groups. The charity performance celebrates SG60, the 96th anniversary of the Nanyang Hakka Association, and the 203rd anniversary of the Huizhou Association. It is planned and directed by Xiao Lijuan, former chairman of the Red Cross Fundraising Committee. Xiao Lijuan is also the president of the Huizhou Association and the deputy general manager of the Nanyang Hakka Association. Guests of honor, Minister of National Development Xu Fangda (left) and show planner and director Xiao Lijuan, contribute to charity together. (Provided by the Red Cross Society) The performance was held at the Singapore Academy of the Arts Concert Hall, bringing together more than 150 performers and volunteers from different backgrounds. The guest of honor, Minister of National Development Xu Fangda, also took the stage to sing and contribute to charity. This is his sixth charity performance for the Singapore Red Cross. The performance raised more than 800,000 yuan for charity. Tan Poh Fong, deputy chairman of the Singapore Red Cross Society, said that the donation will be used to improve the lives of disadvantaged groups, allowing elderly people living alone to obtain medical care; providing round-the-clock care for the disabled; providing assistance to foreign workers when they are in difficulty; helping children, young people and their family members from low-income families to improve their abilities and break the cycle of intergenerational poverty. More than 560 guests attended the performance, including elderly residents from Toa Payoh West-Thomson. title: 升级版居家监测系统 助新加坡红十字会更好监测独居老人动态
description: 升级版居家监测系统 助新加坡红十字会更好监测独居老人动态 新加坡红十字会 推出升级版的居家监测辅助服务（HoME+ 2.0），能够更好地监测独居老人家中的异常状况。 HoME+ 2.0 采用3D动作传感器，取代只能监测移动的传统红外线传感器，它能够监测到4至8米范围内的人员存在，以及他们的动态。四个传感器可安装在厨房、厕所、客厅及卧室。 此外，这套系统也包含一个全新的单向对讲机。当独居老人在家中遇到危险状况时，红十字会的呼叫中心能够通过这系统，联系到这些老人，为他们提供帮助。 新加坡红十字会秘书长兼总裁威廉（Benjamin William）星期三（10月1日）在题为“重塑长者护理：创新、融合与包容”的小组讨论会上说，随着新加坡迈入超老龄化社会，独居年长者人数预计将在2030年增至12万2000名。 “这项服务能够让年长者独立居住，他们也能安心，知道若需要帮助，支援就在身边。” 延伸阅读 年满65岁独居者去年达8万7200人 比前年增11.6% 预防“孤独死” 友诺士弯独居长者家中安装动作感应器 律政部兼社会及家庭发展部高级政务次长蔡瑞隆为HoME+ 2.0主持推介时说：“红十字会的多项努力，让年长者在他们的黄金岁月里有尊严、有目标地生活，促进在社区安宁养老。” 红十字会的居家监测辅助服务2017年推出，现有超过1200名独居年长者使用这项服务，也有160名社区急救员随时待命。 乐龄人士 独居老人 新加坡红十字会 蔡瑞隆 上一篇 骗子假派邻里购物券盗Telegram账号 警方促公众警惕 下一篇 狄澜：淡马锡在上市公司股票的投资高于以往 购买此文章
description_translated: The upgraded home monitoring system helps the Singapore Red Cross better monitor the dynamics of elderly people living alone. The Singapore Red Cross has launched an upgraded version of the home monitoring auxiliary service (HoME+ 2.0) to better monitor abnormal conditions in the homes of elderly people living alone. HoME+ 2.0 uses a 3D motion sensor to replace traditional infrared sensors that can only detect movement. It can detect the presence of people and their movements within a range of 4 to 8 meters. Four sensors can be installed in the kitchen, toilet, living room and bedroom. In addition, the system also includes a new one-way intercom. When elderly people living alone encounter dangerous situations at home, the Red Cross call center can contact these elderly people through this system and provide them with help. Singapore Red Cross Secretary-General and President Benjamin William said at a panel discussion titled "Reshaping Elderly Care: Innovation, Integration and Inclusion" on Wednesday (October 1) that as Singapore enters a super-aging society, the number of elderly people living alone is expected to increase to 122,000 in 2030. "This service allows the elderly to live independently, and they can also feel at ease, knowing that if they need help, support is around them." Further reading: The number of people aged 65 and above living alone reached 87,200 last year, an increase of 11.6% from the previous year. Preventing "lonely death". Motion sensors are installed in the homes of elderly people living alone in Eunos Bend. Senior Parliamentary Secretary of the Ministry of Law and Ministry of Social and Family Development Chua Swee-lung said at the HoME+ When 2.0 hosted the promotion, he said: "The Red Cross's many efforts allow the elderly to live with dignity and purpose in their golden years, and promote peaceful retirement in the community." The Red Cross's home monitoring auxiliary service was launched in 2017. Currently, more than 1,200 elderly people living alone use this service, and 160 community first responders are on standby at any time. title: 卫生科学局与新加坡红十字会推出本地首个捐血者应用
description: 卫生科学局与新加坡红十字会推出本地首个捐血者应用 （早报讯）卫生科学局与新加坡红十字会联合推出本地首个为捐血者而设的手机应用。 该应用名为“DonateBlood”，是国家血液计划数码化的一部分，让捐血者的捐血过程更为便利。 捐血者可通过电子政府密码（SingPass）登录该手机应用，检索到自己的预约时间、捐血记录、电子捐献卡，并且能通过应用来更新个人资料，进行健康评估等。 此外，用户还可通过这一应用查看血库的位置，浏览捐血相关的文章、新闻及活动。 新加坡红十字会秘书长兼总裁本杰明·威廉说：“DonateBlood应用可以让捐血者随时掌握相关信息。我们希望看到更多健康的人，尤其是年轻人能将捐血作为他们生活方式的一部分，激励更多人支持这项拯救生命的事业。” 定期捐血能确保国家有稳定的血液库存供应，而目前本地只有1.8%的居民人口参与捐血，其中仅约四成的人一年至少捐血两次。 卫生科学局敦促身体健康的捐血者能继续定期捐血，并开始使用DonateBlood应用来预约。 卫生科学局 新加坡红十字会 手机应用 上一篇 邱德拔医院设立临时等候区让冠病病患等候转移 下一篇 我国非有地私宅转售价8月份环比上涨0.8％ 购买此文章
description_translated: Health Sciences Authority and Singapore Red Cross launch Singapore’s first blood donor app (Morning News) The Health Sciences Authority and Singapore Red Cross jointly launched Singapore’s first mobile app for blood donors. The app, called "DonateBlood", is part of the digitalization of the National Blood Program and makes the donation process more convenient for blood donors. Blood donors can log in to the mobile application through the electronic government password (SingPass), retrieve their appointment time, blood donation records, and electronic donation cards, and can update personal information, conduct health assessments, etc. through the application. In addition, users can check the location of blood banks and browse blood donation-related articles, news and events through this application. Benjamin William, secretary-general and president of the Singapore Red Cross, said: "The DonateBlood app allows blood donors to keep relevant information at hand. We hope to see more healthy people, especially young people, make blood donation a part of their lifestyle, inspiring more people to support this life-saving cause." Regular blood donation can ensure that the country has a stable supply of blood inventory. However, currently only 1.8% of the local population participates in blood donation, and only about 40% of them donate blood at least twice a year. The Health Sciences Authority urges healthy blood donors to continue donating blood regularly and to start using the DonateBlood app to make appointments. title: 明年1月起 首次捐血者年龄上限从60岁调高至65岁
description: 明年1月起 首次捐血者年龄上限从60岁调高至65岁 为应对超老龄社会的需求，从明年1月1日起，首次捐血者的年龄上限，将从60岁调高至65岁，以扩大捐血者群体。 新加坡红十字会和卫生科学局星期六（6月28日）举办世界献血者日庆祝活动，活动主宾社会政策统筹部长兼卫生部长 王乙康 致辞时宣布以上消息。 他指出，人口老龄化加剧了我国对血液的需求，而供应却因合格捐血者人数的减少而受到限制。新捐血者的数量也在下滑，从2013年的超过2万人，降至2024年的约1.8万人。 根据新加坡红十字会和卫生科学局发布的文告，人口老龄化带来了双重挑战，60岁及以上病患目前占总红血球使用量的60%，而合格捐血者的数量却在减少。自2013年以来，新捐血者人数下降了超过11%，这一趋势令人担忧，因为我国对血液的需求只会持续增加。 王乙康指出，人口老龄化加剧了我国对血液的需求，而供应却因合格捐血者人数的减少而受到限制。（唐家鸿摄） 王乙康说，许多愿意贡献力量的年长者，因首次捐血的60岁年龄限制而无法捐血。这一规定的初衷是为了确保体质较弱的年长者，在捐血后不会出现不良副作用。 延伸阅读 六旬叔捐血42年累计348次 排前三名 “世界献血者日”说捐血 一袋热血 生灵有望 不过，随着我国预期寿命的延长，60岁及以上的人通常更加健康。本地数据也显示，在首次捐血者中，随着年龄接近60岁限制，不良反应者实际上有所减少。因此，不良反应预计不会在60岁之后突然增加。 卫生科学局决定从明年1月1日起，把首次捐血者的年龄上限提高至65岁。这一举措与香港、台湾、爱尔兰、荷兰、韩国、英国等地的捐血服务国际惯例保持一致。 王乙康在星期六上午举行的颁奖仪式上，向2076名捐血者和37个组织颁奖，表扬他们对拯救生命和全国捐血计划的宝贵贡献。 王乙康 新加坡红十字会 卫生科学局 捐血 老龄化社会 上一篇 乌敏岛完成基建升级 五甘榜屋将修复供社区商业使用 下一篇 罗厘吊臂过高撞天桥 42岁司机被捕 购买此文章
description_translated: Starting from January next year, the upper age limit for first-time blood donors will be raised from 60 to 65. In order to meet the needs of a super-aging society, starting from January 1 next year, the upper age limit for first-time blood donors will be raised from 60 to 65 years old to expand the pool of blood donors. The Singapore Red Cross and the Health Sciences Authority held a World Blood Donor Day celebration on Saturday (June 28). The guest of honor at the event, Coordinating Minister for Social Policy and Minister of Health Ong Ye Kung, announced the above news in his speech. He noted that the country's aging population has exacerbated the country's need for blood, while supply is limited by a shrinking pool of qualified donors. The number of new blood donors is also declining, from more than 20,000 in 2013 to about 18,000 in 2024. According to a statement issued by the Singapore Red Cross and the Health Sciences Authority, the aging population poses dual challenges. Patients aged 60 and above currently account for 60% of total red blood cell usage, while the number of qualified blood donors is decreasing. The number of new blood donors has dropped by more than 11% since 2013, a worrying trend as our country's need for blood will only continue to increase. Ong Ye Kung pointed out that the country's aging population has exacerbated the country's demand for blood, while supply is limited by the decline in the number of qualified blood donors. (Photo by Tang Jiahong) Wang Yekang said that many elderly people who are willing to contribute are unable to donate blood due to the 60-year-old age limit for first-time donation. The original intention of this regulation is to ensure that elderly people with weak constitutions will not suffer adverse side effects after donating blood. Extended reading: Sixty-year-old uncle has donated blood a total of 348 times in 42 years, ranking in the top three. "World Blood Donor Day" said that donating blood can save lives with a bag of warm blood. However, as life expectancy in our country increases, people aged 60 and above are generally healthier. Local data also shows that among first-time blood donors, adverse reactions actually decrease as the age approaches the 60-year-old limit. title: 青年捐血者比率十年减半 红十字会新计划鼓励青年定期捐血
description: 青年捐血者比率十年减半 红十字会新计划鼓励青年定期捐血 过去十年，我国捐血者中青年的比率大幅下降，从2013年的31%降至去年的15%。新加坡红十字会发起新计划，鼓励青年加入捐血行列，希望到2030年将青年捐血者的比率提高至25%。 配合世界献血者日，新加坡红十字会星期六（6月29日）联合卫生科学局举行颁奖典礼，表彰1961名长期捐血者和23个捐血冠军组织，感谢他们对全国捐血计划的持续支持。 通讯及新闻部兼卫生部政务部长拉哈尤出席典礼，并颁奖给获奖者。为确保我国血液供应可持续，拉哈尤宣布启动“启发青年”（YouthInspired）计划，通过校园推广、组织对话会与宣传活动等方式，鼓励年龄介于16岁至25岁的青年积极捐血。 虽然去年的总体捐血者从前年的7万4150人增加到7万7424人，捐出的血液也从11万7967单位增多至12万2668单位，但新加坡红十字会希望通过计划，提高青年捐血者人数，在未来五年内，吸引500名青年参与定期捐血。 谈及青年捐血人数下降的原因，新加坡红十字会透露，之前受冠病疫情的影响，许多捐血和学校推广活动被迫取消，包括在高等学府和社区内进行的捐血活动。 延伸阅读 人协与红十字会合作 鼓励民众积极捐血 去年逾7.7万人捐血 王乙康吁更多年轻人捐血 人口老龄化增加血液需求 拉哈尤在致辞时说，随着新加坡人口迅速老龄化，对血液的需求也将增加。“65岁及以上的公民现在占我国人口的近五分之一，十年前这一比率为11.7%。” 她指出，卫科局的研究显示，60岁及以上的患者，血液使用量占总数的60%。“随着年龄的增长，人们更容易患贫血或多种合并症，须输血的可能性也会增加。” 在颁奖典礼现场，约有230人报名捐血。（林明顺摄） 同时，癌症已成为血液消耗量的重要因素，占新加坡血液总消耗量的10%，患者可能因癌症本身或治疗引起的贫血而须输血。 随着过去50年来癌症发病率上升和人口老龄化，这一趋势预计将持续。 此外，遗传性贫血患者的人均用血量最高。例如，地中海贫血症（thalassemia）患者每三到四周就需要输血一次，以维持健康。 通讯及新闻部兼卫生部政务部长拉哈尤致辞时说，随着新加坡人口迅速老龄化，对血液的需求也将增加。（林明顺摄） 新加坡红十字会主席陈开河致辞时说，除了在紧急情况下和手术中需要血液，在治疗某些危及生命的疾病，如地中海贫血和白血病时，也经常要靠定期输血来确保治疗正常进行。 他提到，每年捐血的人约占新加坡居民人口的1.8％，也就是我国的输血需求由大约7万7000人献血应付。 他也说，红十字会将继续与学校开展合作，组织学生前往血库参观学习，以鼓励更多青年参与捐血活动。 蔡祖儿（25岁，南洋理工大学生）已捐血至少20次，因此在颁奖典礼上获得表彰。 她受访时说，母亲是护士，耳濡目染之下，她从17岁开始捐血。当她明白到有很多人需要输血后，她就定期捐血。 她忆述，18岁去捐血时，因为血液缺血红蛋白（Haemoglobin），两次被拒，于是她多吃菠菜、牛肉等食品补血, 一个星期后再去捐血。 谈及持续捐血的动力来源，她说：“每天都有人须要用到血液，自己的小小举动能帮助别人，感觉很有满足感。朋友第一次去捐血，我通常都会陪着去，在精神上支持他们。” 她也提到，父亲起初因错误观念，担心对她身体有害而不支持她捐血。“其实，对健康是没有影响的，而且这是一份善念和爱心，应该坚持下去。” 红十字会官方网站注明，捐血者必须年龄介于16岁至60岁，体重至少达45公斤；女性血红蛋白水平至少为每分升12.5克（g/dL），男性血红蛋白水平至少为每分升13.0克。 从去年2月起，血红蛋白未达标者，重新检测并捐血的时间间隔要求从一个星期改为一个月。 新加坡红十字会 拉哈尤·玛赞 捐血 青年 上一篇 逾万名小五生提前为国家庆生 烟花和红狮跳伞队最受欢迎 下一篇 微电影大赛迎两组双料得主 首设最佳环境主题奖 购买此文章
description_translated: The rate of young blood donors has halved in ten years. The Red Cross’s new plan encourages young people to donate blood regularly. In the past ten years, the rate of young blood donors in my country has dropped significantly, from 31% in 2013 to 15% last year. The Singapore Red Cross has launched a new plan to encourage young people to join the ranks of blood donors, hoping to increase the rate of young blood donors to 25% by 2030. In conjunction with World Blood Donor Day, the Singapore Red Cross and the Health Sciences Authority held an awards ceremony on Saturday (June 29) to recognize 1,961 long-term blood donors and 23 blood donation champion organizations for their continued support of the national blood donation program. Rahayu, Minister of State for the Ministry of Communications and Information and Health, attended the ceremony and presented awards to the winners. In order to ensure the sustainability of blood supply in the country, Rahayu announced the launch of the "YouthInspired" program to encourage young people aged between 16 and 25 to actively donate blood through campus promotion, organizing dialogues and publicity activities. Although the total number of blood donors last year increased to 77,424 from 74,150 the year before, and the number of donated blood also increased from 117,967 units to 122,668 units, the Singapore Red Cross hopes to increase the number of young blood donors through a plan and attract 500 young people to participate in regular blood donation in the next five years. Talking about the reasons for the decline in the number of youth blood donations, the Singapore Red Cross revealed that due to the impact of the COVID-19 epidemic, many blood donations and school promotion activities had to be canceled, including blood donation activities in higher education institutions and communities. Extended reading The People's Association of People's Association and the Red Cross cooperate to encourage people to actively donate blood. Last year, more than 77,000 people donated blood. Ong Ye Kung called on more young people to donate blood. The aging population increases the demand for blood. In his speech, Rahayu said that as Singapore's population ages rapidly, the demand for blood will also increase. "Citizens aged 65 and above now account for nearly one-fifth of our country's population. Ten years ago, this ratio was 11.7%." She pointed out that research from the Bureau of Health Science and Technology showed that patients aged 60 and above accounted for 60% of the total blood usage. "As people age, they are more likely to suffer from anemia or multiple comorbidities, and the possibility of needing blood transfusions will also increase." At the award ceremony, about 230 people signed up to donate blood. (Photo by Lim Ming Soon) At the same time, cancer has become an important factor in blood consumption, accounting for 10% of total blood consumption in Singapore. Patients may require blood transfusions due to anemia caused by the cancer itself or treatment. As cancer rates have increased over the past 50 years and the population has aged, this trend is expected to continue. In addition, patients with hereditary anemia have the highest per capita blood consumption. For example, people with thalassemia need blood transfusions every three to four weeks to stay healthy. In his speech, Rahayu, Minister of State for Communications and Information and Health, said that as Singapore's population ages rapidly, the demand for blood will also increase. (Photo by Lim Meng Soon) Singapore Red Cross Chairman Tan Kai Ho said in his speech that in addition to the need for blood in emergencies and operations, when treating certain life-threatening diseases, such as thalassemia and leukemia, regular blood transfusions are often required to ensure normal treatment. He mentioned that the number of people donating blood every year accounts for about 1.8% of Singapore's resident population, which means that the country's blood transfusion needs are met by about 77,000 people donating blood. He also said that the Red Cross will continue to cooperate with schools and organize students to visit blood banks to encourage more young people to participate in blood donation activities. Choi Choi (25 years old, Nanyang Technological University student) has donated blood at least 20 times and was commended at the award ceremony. In an interview, she said that her mother was a nurse and she started donating blood at the age of 17 under the influence of her parents. When she realized that many people needed blood transfusions, she started donating blood regularly. She recalled that when she went to donate blood at the age of 18, she was rejected twice because of her blood's ischemic hemoglobin (Haemoglobin), so she ate more spinach, beef and other foods to replenish her blood, and then went to donate blood a week later. Talking about the source of her motivation to continue donating blood, she said: "Every day, people need blood. My small actions can help others, which makes me feel very satisfied. When my friends donate blood for the first time, I usually accompany them and support them mentally." She also mentioned that her father initially did not support her donating blood due to misconceptions and was worried that it would be harmful to her body. "Actually, it has no impact on health, and this is a kind thought and love, so you should stick to it." The official website of the Red Cross states that blood donors must be between 16 and 60 years old and weigh at least 45 kilograms; the hemoglobin level for women is at least 12.5 grams per deciliter (g/dL), and the hemoglobin level for men is at least 13.0 grams per deciliter. Starting from February last year, for those whose hemoglobin did not meet the target, the time interval for retesting and donating blood was changed from one week to one month. title: 巴勒斯坦红新月会总部遭袭 红十字会与红新月会国际联合会谴责
description: 巴勒斯坦红新月会总部遭袭 红十字会与红新月会国际联合会谴责 红十字会与红新月会国际联合会（IFRC）星期天（8月3日）发表声明，谴责针对位于加沙地带汗尤尼斯的巴勒斯坦红新月会总部的袭击，同时强烈呼吁各方保护平民和人道主义工作者，尊重并保护红新月标志。 声明说，标有清晰红新月标志的总部建筑多次遭到袭击，导致巴勒斯坦红新月会工作人员伊斯利姆遇害，另有两名工作人员和一名在现场救火的平民受伤。 声明指出，根据国际人道主义法，红新月标志本应保障其工作人员安全，但自2023年10月7日巴以新一轮以哈冲突爆发以来，已有51名巴勒斯坦红新月会工作人员和志愿者丧生，其中31人在遇难时正在执行任务且佩戴红新月标志。 声明重申，必须保护平民和人道主义工作者，必须尊重并保护红新月标志，任何针对其设施或人员的袭击都是对人道援助的袭击。 巴勒斯坦红新月会说，以色列袭击了位于加沙地带汗尤尼斯的巴勒斯坦红新月会总部，造成一人死亡、三人受伤，还导致总部建筑一层起火。 红十字会与红新月会国际联合会成立于1919年，总部设在瑞士日内瓦。 红十字会 以哈冲突 以色列 加沙地带 上一篇 也门海域移民船翻覆 至少68人死74人下落不明 下一篇 澳大利亚启动新一阶段旅游推广
description_translated: The International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies condemned the attack on the headquarters of the Palestinian Red Crescent Society. The International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies (IFRC) issued a statement on Sunday (August 3) condemning the attack on the headquarters of the Palestinian Red Crescent Society in Khan Younis, Gaza Strip. It also strongly called on all parties to protect civilians and humanitarian workers and respect and protect the Red Crescent emblem. The statement said that the headquarters building with a clear Red Crescent logo was attacked multiple times, resulting in the death of Palestinian Red Crescent staff member Islim, and the injuries to two other staff members and a civilian who was fighting the fire at the scene. The statement pointed out that in accordance with international humanitarian law, the Red Crescent emblem should ensure the safety of its staff. However, since the outbreak of a new round of Israeli-Palestinian conflict between Israel and Kazakhstan on October 7, 2023, 51 Palestinian Red Crescent Society staff and volunteers have lost their lives, 31 of whom were performing tasks and wearing the Red Crescent emblem when they were killed. The statement reiterated that civilians and humanitarian workers must be protected, and the Red Crescent emblem must be respected and protected. Any attack on its facilities or personnel is an attack on humanitarian assistance. The Palestinian Red Crescent Society said that Israel attacked the headquarters of the Palestinian Red Crescent Society in Khan Younis, Gaza Strip, killing one person, injuring three people, and causing a fire on the first floor of the headquarters building. The International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies was founded in 1919 and is headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland. title: 红十字国际委员会：将协助在押人员获释
description: 红十字国际委员会：将协助在押人员获释 红十字国际委员会就以色列与巴勒斯坦伊斯兰抵抗运动（哈马斯）达成第一阶段停火协议发表声明，敦促各方恪守承诺，并表示已准备好协助在押人员获释。 委员会星期五（10月10日）的声明指出，以色列与哈马斯达成的停火协议为挽救生命、减轻苦难提供重要契机，必须成为持续两年的加沙地带惨烈局势的转折点。 中国新闻社引述声明称，红十字国际委员会驻以色列、加沙地带及约旦河西岸的工作组将支持落实该协议，协助在押人员回到家人身边。同时准备好协助移交逝者遗体，让家属能够有尊严地哀悼亲人。 声明还称，该委员会工作组也准备好向加沙地带运送更多挽救生命的援助物资，并安全地派发给需求最为迫切的民众。 “未来几天至关重要”，红十字国际委员会主席斯波利亚里茨强调，“我敦促各方恪守承诺。释放（在押人员的）行动必须以安全且维护他们尊严的方式进行”。 延伸阅读 加沙停火第一阶段协议生效 以军撤离部分地区 美国将派军“监督”加沙停火协议执行情况 她还强调，无论加沙民众身在何处，援助物资必须安全送达他们手中。 以色列方面10日宣布，加沙停火协议已于当地时间10日12时（新加坡时间10日17时）生效。根据协议，以军完成撤军后，哈马斯将在72小时内释放所有以色列人员并归还已逝人员遗体，以色列将释放约2000名巴勒斯坦人。同时，数百辆运载食品和医疗物资的卡车将能进入加沙地带。 据红十字国际委员会统计，自2023年10月新一轮巴以冲突爆发以来，该委员会已协助148名以方人员和1931名巴方人员获释。 加沙地带 巴勒斯坦 中东冲突 以色列 上一篇 加沙停火第一阶段协议生效 以军撤离部分地区 下一篇 美政府“停摆”继续 本周2万多航班延误
description_translated: International Committee of the Red Cross: Will assist in the release of detainees The International Committee of the Red Cross issued a statement on the first phase of the ceasefire agreement between Israel and the Palestinian Islamic Resistance Movement (Hamas), urging all parties to abide by their commitments and stating that it was ready to facilitate the release of detainees. The committee's statement on Friday (October 10) pointed out that the ceasefire agreement reached between Israel and Hamas provides an important opportunity to save lives and alleviate suffering, and must become a turning point in the tragic situation in the Gaza Strip that has lasted for two years. China News Agency quoted the statement as saying that the ICRC's working teams in Israel, the Gaza Strip and the West Bank will support the implementation of the agreement and assist detainees in returning to their families. At the same time, we are ready to assist in the transfer of the remains of the deceased so that family members can mourn their loved ones with dignity. The statement also said that the committee's working group is also ready to deliver more life-saving aid to the Gaza Strip and safely distribute it to people in most urgent need. "The next few days will be crucial," stressed Spoliarits, president of the International Committee of the Red Cross. "I urge all parties to abide by their commitments. The release (of detainees) must be carried out safely and in a manner that respects their dignity." Extended reading: The first phase of the Gaza ceasefire agreement takes effect and Israeli troops withdraw from some areas. The United States will send troops to "supervise" the implementation of the Gaza ceasefire agreement. She also emphasized that no matter where the Gaza people are, aid supplies must be safely delivered to them. Israel announced on the 10th that the Gaza ceasefire agreement had entered into force at 12:00 local time on the 10th (17:00 Singapore time on the 10th). According to the agreement, after the Israeli army completes its withdrawal, Hamas will release all Israeli personnel and return the remains of the deceased within 72 hours, and Israel will release approximately 2,000 Palestinians. At the same time, hundreds of trucks carrying food and medical supplies will be able to enter the Gaza Strip. According to statistics from the International Committee of the Red Cross, since the outbreak of the new round of Palestinian-Israeli conflict in October 2023, the Committee has assisted in the release of 148 Israeli personnel and 1,931 Palestinian personnel. title: 接任红十字会主席 陈开河聚焦“新弱势群体”
description: 接任红十字会主席 陈开河聚焦“新弱势群体” 红十字会新主席陈开河受访时说，新加坡红十字会过去71年来奠定了稳固基础，救济弱势、保护生命的基本使命不会改变。而随着冠病疫情的发展，社会悬殊现象加剧，红十字会下来也将关注和支援新弱势群体，为本地弱势家庭提供更多支援。 在冠病疫情下接掌新加坡红十字会，新任主席陈开河除了要延续这个慈善组织扶弱赈灾的使命，也要让它更有效地援助本地因疫情出现的新弱势群体，并且提升应对环球疫情的能力。 新加坡红十字会昨天发文告宣布，淡马锡控股旗下精密工程与科技集团Accuron Technologies总裁陈开河（54岁）获哈莉玛总统委任，今天正式从领导红十字会12年的郑大峇（78岁）手中接棒，出任本地红十字会新主席。 具备公共服务和私人领域经验的陈开河，从中学时代就读莱佛士书院时参加红十字会青年团开始，便与红十字会结缘。 他为红十字会理事会前后服务约九年，过去近四年担任副主席。他约五年前加入Accuron Technologies，之前曾在2013年5月至2015年7月间担任标新局局长。标新局前年和国际企业发展局合并成新加坡企业发展局。加入标新局之前，陈开河曾任新加坡武装部队海军参谋长等要职。 陈开河日前接受《联合早报》访问时说，新加坡红十字会过去71年来奠定了稳固基础，它救济弱势、保护生命的基本使命不会改变。“但随着冠病疫情的发展，社会悬殊现象加剧，一些新的需求会产生，一些平时不需要援助的群体，下来也可能会陷入困境，红十字会需要关注和支援这些新群体。” 红十字会已落实多项措施，并准备为本地弱势家庭提供更多支援。这包括4月起每月针对500名弱势年长者的需求，赠送包含食品、医疗和日用品的爱心礼包。陈开河认为，红十字下来可为弱势年长者做更多，包括扩大看诊接送服务、友伴计划，以及为更多独居年长者提供“居家监测辅助服务”（HoME+），通过装置感应器，预防他们在家中病倒无人知。 过去几个月，红十字会也积极向外籍客工伸出援手，包括在疫情暴发初期为他们分发基本必需品。下来几个月，它会继续为客工分派生活物资，减轻他们的日常开销负担。红十字会也将探讨与其他社服机构加强协作，取长补短，善用资源，更好地帮助弱势。 与亚细安伙伴合作成立 全球大流行病应对中心 红十字会已开始迈向数码化转型，陈开河希望继续推动这项工作，包括加强网络募款能力，及完善现有的义工管理系统，让红十字会更有效地调派义工。 另一方面，他相信红十字会的国际赈灾工作和角色也会进一步延伸和演变，除了救济天灾人祸，也会加强应对全球疫情的能力。新加坡红十字会正同亚细安伙伴合作成立全球大流行病应对中心，加强有关的培训和知识共享。 前警察总监郑大峇服务红十字会理事会13年，其中12年担任主席。他在任内推动数项制度改革，包括在2012年带领红十字会进行结构重组的检讨工作。对于红十字会加强对本地弱势群体的援助项目以及国际赈灾能力方面，郑大峇做出了重要贡献。 哈莉玛总统是红十字会赞助人。总统在文告中除了表扬郑大峇大力推动红十字会义工文化，彰显出该组织人道救助的精神，也对接棒主席的陈开河表示有信心。“我相信以陈开河在私人和公共服务领域的经验，能为红十字会增添不同的经验和视角，进一步鼓励人们支持人道援助的使命。” 购买此文章
description_translated: Chen Kaihe, who takes over as chairman of the Red Cross, focuses on "new vulnerable groups". In an interview, the new chairman of the Red Cross, Chen Kaihe, said that the Singapore Red Cross has laid a solid foundation over the past 71 years and its basic mission of relieving the disadvantaged and protecting lives will not change. As the COVID-19 epidemic develops and social disparities intensify, the Red Cross will also pay attention to and support new vulnerable groups and provide more support to local disadvantaged families. Taking over the leadership of the Singapore Red Cross during the COVID-19 epidemic, the new chairman Chen Kaihe will not only continue the charity organization's mission of supporting the disadvantaged and providing disaster relief, but also make it more effective in assisting new vulnerable groups in the local area due to the epidemic, and improve its ability to respond to the global epidemic. The Singapore Red Cross issued a statement yesterday announcing that Chen Kaihe (54), president of Accuron Technologies, a precision engineering and technology group under Temasek Holdings, was appointed by President Halimah Yacob. Today, he officially took over from Cheng Daba (78), who has led the Red Cross for 12 years, as the new chairman of the local Red Cross. Chen Kaihe, who has experience in public service and the private sector, has been associated with the Red Cross since he joined the Red Cross Youth League when he was a student at Raffles Institution in middle school. He has served on the Red Cross Board of Directors for approximately nine years, serving as Vice Chairman for the past nearly four years. He joined Accuron Technologies about five years ago and previously served as Director-General of SPRING from May 2013 to July 2015. The year before last, SPRING merged with International Enterprise to form Enterprise Singapore. Before joining SPRING, Chen Kaihe served as chief of naval staff of the Singapore Armed Forces and other important positions. In a recent interview with Lianhe Zaobao, Chen Kaihe said that the Singapore Red Cross has laid a solid foundation over the past 71 years and its basic mission of relieving the disadvantaged and protecting lives will not change. "However, as the COVID-19 epidemic develops and social disparities intensify, some new needs will arise. Some groups that usually do not need assistance may find themselves in trouble. The Red Cross needs to pay attention to and support these new groups." The Red Cross has implemented a number of measures and is preparing to provide more support to local disadvantaged families. This includes giving away charity gift packages containing food, medical care and daily necessities to 500 vulnerable elderly people every month starting from April. Chen Kaihe believes that the Red Cross can do more for disadvantaged elderly people, including expanding medical pick-up and drop-off services, companionship programs, and providing "Home Monitoring Assistance Services" (HoME+) for more elderly people living alone, by installing sensors to prevent them from getting sick at home without anyone noticing. In the past few months, the Red Cross has also actively extended a helping hand to foreign guest workers, including distributing basic necessities to them in the early stages of the outbreak. In the coming months, it will continue to distribute daily necessities to guest workers to reduce their burden of daily expenses. The Red Cross will also explore strengthening collaboration with other social service agencies to learn from each other's strengths and make better use of resources to better help the disadvantaged. The Global Pandemic Response Center was established in cooperation with ASEAN partners. The Red Cross has begun to move towards digital transformation. Chen Kaihe hopes to continue to promote this work, including strengthening online fundraising capabilities and improving the existing volunteer management system, so that the Red Cross can dispatch volunteers more effectively. On the other hand, he believes that the Red Cross's international disaster relief work and role will further expand and evolve. In addition to relieving natural and man-made disasters, it will also strengthen its ability to respond to global epidemics. The Singapore Red Cross is working with ASEAN partners to establish a global pandemic response center to strengthen relevant training and knowledge sharing. Former Police Commissioner Zheng Daba served on the Red Cross Board of Directors for 13 years, including 12 years as chairman. He promoted several institutional reforms during his tenure, including leading the Red Cross to conduct a review of structural reorganization in 2012. Zheng Daba has made important contributions to the Red Cross's strengthening of assistance projects for local vulnerable groups and international disaster relief capabilities. President Halimah Yacob is a patron of the Red Cross. In the statement, the President not only praised Zheng Daba for vigorously promoting the volunteer culture of the Red Cross and demonstrating the organization's spirit of humanitarian relief, but also expressed confidence in Chen Kaihe, who will take over as chairman. "I believe that with Chen Kaihe's experience in private and public service, he can add different experiences and perspectives to the Red Cross and further encourage people to support the mission of humanitarian aid." title: 学生义工救伤助人
description: 学生义工救伤助人 涂惠莉在校园捐血活动中了解到红十字会，后加入成为义工，并多次参与急救工作。 从参加校园的捐血活动，到成为红十字会的活跃义工，涂惠莉利用急救技能服务社会，也因此感到自足。 涂惠莉（24岁）是新加坡理工大学系统工程学（机电系统）四年级的学生。新加坡红十字会义工队伍共有7000人，她是其中的一员。 “我几年前在义安理工学院念书时，在校园的捐血活动中了解到红十字会，决定加入红十字会的青年团义安工院分队。” 除了协调工院的捐血活动，涂惠莉也在学校的各项活动中担任急救员。 “好笑的是，我第一个急救的对象，居然是自己。”原来，她在马来西亚参加工院的外展训练，玩卡丁车时扭伤了脚。她立即遵照标准急救作业方式，为自己处理伤况。 还有一次，她到中国天津参加学校浸濡计划。一名讲师在公园内因路滑跌倒，脚部受伤，她第一时间协助讲师包扎伤口。 涂惠莉现担任红十字会的社区急救员和流动急救员（First Aider on Wheels），并参与了今年国庆庆典的急救工作。与国庆表演者一样，两个月内，她每个周末都要彩排。国庆日当天，她和队员必须保持高度警惕，随时准备应对突发状况。 周末，涂惠莉会到东海岸公园和乌敏岛巡逻。她遇到的最严重的一起事故就发生在东海岸公园，当时一辆电动踏板车与一辆脚踏车相撞，两名骑士都没戴安全头盔，脚踏车女骑士头部受伤流血。在等候救护车的过程中，她为女骑士清洗和包扎了伤口。 她提醒在公园骑行的人，“注意安全，戴好头盔！” 街访街坊 新加坡红十字会 义工 捐血 上一篇 改进商业技术来运用 国防专才提高成本效益 下一篇 卫生部通过加强预防等措施 应对失智症患者剧增问题 购买此文章
description_translated: Student volunteers rescue the injured and help others. Tu Huili learned about the Red Cross during a blood donation event on campus, and later joined as a volunteer and participated in first aid work many times. From participating in blood donation activities on campus to becoming an active volunteer with the Red Cross, Tu Huili uses her first aid skills to serve the society and feels self-sufficient. Tu Huili (24 years old) is a fourth-year system engineering (electromechanical systems) student at Singapore Institute of Technology. She is one of the 7,000 volunteers in the Singapore Red Cross Society. "When I was studying at Ngee Ann Polytechnic a few years ago, I learned about the Red Cross during a blood donation event on campus and decided to join the Ngee Ann Polytechnic branch of the Red Cross Youth League." In addition to coordinating the blood donation activities of the Polytechnic, To Huili also serves as a first-aider in various activities at the school. "What's funny is that the first person I gave first aid to was myself." It turned out that she was participating in the outreach training of the Institute of Technology in Malaysia and sprained her foot while playing go-kart. She immediately followed standard first aid practices and treated her injuries. Another time, she went to Tianjin, China to participate in a school immersion program. A lecturer fell due to a slippery road in the park and injured his foot. She immediately helped the lecturer bandage the wound. Tu Huili currently serves as a community first responder and mobile first responder (First Aider on Wheels) of the Red Cross, and participated in the first aid work for this year's National Day celebration. Like the National Day performers, she rehearsed every weekend for two months. On National Day, she and her team members must remain highly vigilant and be ready to deal with emergencies at any time. On weekends, Tu Huili patrols East Coast Park and Pulau Ubin. The most serious accident she encountered occurred in East Coast Park, when an electric scooter collided with a bicycle. Neither rider was wearing a safety helmet. The female bicycle rider suffered head injuries and bleeding. While waiting for the ambulance, she cleaned and bandaged the female knight's wounds. She reminded people riding in the park, "Pay attention to safety and wear a helmet!" Tu Huili currently serves as a community first responder and mobile first responder (First Aider on Wheels) of the Red Cross, and participated in the first aid work for this year's National Day celebration. Like the National Day performers, she rehearsed every weekend for two months. On National Day, she and her team members must remain highly vigilant and be ready to deal with emergencies at any time. On weekends, Tu Huili patrols East Coast Park and Pulau Ubin. The most serious accident she encountered occurred in East Coast Park, when an electric scooter collided with a bicycle. Neither rider was wearing a safety helmet. The female bicycle rider suffered head injuries and bleeding. While waiting for the ambulance, she cleaned and bandaged the female knight's wounds. She reminded people riding in the park, "Pay attention to safety and wear a helmet!"
